purpose: Everything the base-M1 owner needs to run the compiler's H13 packages once the ANE-enabled boot and driver are confirmed. Artifact readiness is not permission to submit.

package.anec_layout: 0x1000-byte header, 0x274-byte task descriptor at 0x1000, constants at content offset 0x280, 0x4000-byte tiles
package.manifest: programs[], dispatchPlan[], intermediates[]; per-program inputs/outputs carry logical shape, ANEC channel index, physical nchw layout, logicalBytes, allocationBytes; folded constants appear as constantInputs hex plus binding=constant
package.buffer_conversion: python3 research/inspect_anec.py PACKAGE --pack-input NAME dense.fp16 --output physical.buffer | --pack-constant NAME --output physical.buffer | --unpack-output NAME physical.buffer --output dense.fp16

supported_now: add, mul, maximum, minimum on any identical 64-element fp16 shape with two runtime inputs
add, mul, maximum, minimum, sub, real_div with one runtime input and one 64-element fp16 constant (sub negates; real_div needs exact fp16 reciprocals)
matmul x[K] with K in {256, 512} against constant W[K,512] or W[512,K]^T producing 512 outputs, including rank-1, singleton-batch, and transposed single-vector forms
straight-line chains of the above, one program per operation
first_hardware_checks: add with a=index*0.125 patterns and b=index*0.25 patterns; expect exact fp16 sums (same oracle as tests/hardware/run_alu.mm)
matvec K=256 with the dense test weights from tests/test_h13_cli.py; compare against a CPU fp32-accumulated fp16 reference
a two-program chain add->mul; the intermediate buffer is the first program's output channel 4 and the second program's input channel 5
prerequisites_from_peer: Verified ANE-enabled Linux boot with the device-tree node present
Exact driver and libane identities, and confirmation that the loader accepts the 0x1000-byte ANEC header and the channel 4/5/6 binding contract
Explicit hardware handoff for this session
